$comment: Engine catalog — English (the only launch locale, ADR 0019). Keys are dotted, area-first. Values use {param} placeholders; plurals are objects keyed by CLDR category selected via a 'count' param. Adding a locale = adding a sibling file (e.g. pt-BR.json); zero code changes. i18n/keys.gen.json (generated by apigen + the i18n lint) inventories every key referenced from code; CI fails on keys missing here.

engine.overlay.look.wrong_parent_effect: Does nothing here. An effect counts only directly under Lighting, where it is the world's, or directly under the current camera, where it belongs to whoever looks through it.
engine.overlay.look.wrong_parent_environ: Does nothing here. An Atmosphere or a Sky counts only directly under Lighting.
engine.overlay.look.not_first: Not used: only the first one of these directly under Lighting counts.
engine.overlay.look.fog_replaced: FogStart, FogEnd and FogColor are kept but not used: the Atmosphere under Lighting replaces the linear fog. Remove it and they apply again.
engine.overlay.look.outranked: Not used: an earlier enabled effect of the same kind wins. Lighting's effects come first, in order, then the camera's.

The same places hold the same chunks, and one lap lagging behind another moves single places rather than the median, so what is left over is a leak rather than a budget.

engine.lost.editor:
The graphics card stopped responding and was reset -- most often because a shader ran longer than the driver allows. Nothing more can be drawn in this window.

The surface shaders that were on screen are held back until you change them, so the editor can restart safely.

engine.editor.terrain.create.ask_hills_d: Every column in the square takes the hills' height. One ctrl-Z brings it back.
engine.editor.terrain.create.clear_tip: removes every bit of ground, and keeps the terrain and its settings. One ctrl-Z brings it back
engine.editor.terrain.create.create_tip: adds a Terrain to the world with flat ground, ready to sculpt
engine.editor.terrain.create.export_tip: writes the ground's heights across the square as a 16-bit PNG and a RAW under the project's heightmaps/, black at the world's floor and white at its ceiling, with the size and heights beside them for the import
engine.editor.terrain.create.height_tip: the world height the ground's surface is laid at
engine.editor.terrain.create.heights_tip: the lowest valley and the highest top, in world heights
engine.editor.terrain.create.hills_tip: lays hills across the square, made of the brush's material. One ctrl-Z brings it back
engine.editor.terrain.create.made_of: made of {name}; choose another under Paint
engine.editor.terrain.create.octaves_tip: how many sizes of smaller hills ride on the large ones: more is rougher
engine.editor.terrain.create.replace_fla: levels the whole square to this height, ground sculpted inside it included; ground outside the square stays. One ctrl-Z brings it back
engine.editor.terrain.create.scale_tip: how far apart the largest hills are
engine.editor.terrain.foliage.add_layer_: a layer that grows on every material of this terrain; set its rules in Properties
engine.editor.terrain.foliage.add_mesh_t: a mesh the chosen layer grows; pick its Mesh in Properties
engine.editor.terrain.foliage.brush_down: Pick Restore or Thin, then drag over the ground.
engine.editor.terrain.foliage.none: Nothing grows here yet. Add a layer, then give it a mesh.
engine.editor.terrain.foliage.restore_ti: puts back what was thinned, up to what the layer's rules grow; where it grows at all is its rules', in Properties. Ctrl thins
engine.editor.terrain.foliage.thin_tip: thins the chosen layer, to nothing at the brush's centre. Ctrl restores
engine.editor.terrain.heightmap.import_t: replaces the ground's height across the square; caves are left as they are, and one ctrl-Z takes it back
engine.editor.terrain.heightmap.intro: ground from a greyscale image: black is the lowest height, white the highest. 16-bit PNG and RAW keep smooth slopes; 8-bit shows steps
engine.editor.terrain.heightmap.past_ran: past the terrain's height range; widen it under Setup or it is clamped
engine.editor.terrain.heightmap.size_tip: how wide the image is laid, centred on the terrain's position
engine.editor.terrain.keys.foliage: [ ] size  |  Shift+[ ] strength  |  hold Ctrl: thin  |  Esc puts the brush down
engine.editor.terrain.keys.paint: [ ] size  |  Shift+[ ] strength  |  hold Ctrl: erase while blending  |  Esc puts the brush down
engine.editor.terrain.keys.sculpt: 1-6 pick a tool  |  [ ] size  |  Shift+[ ] strength  |  hold Ctrl: the opposite  |  hold Shift: smooth  |  Esc puts the brush down
engine.editor.terrain.layers.add_tip: add one of the project's materials to the terrain -- or drag one here from Content
engine.editor.terrain.layers.no_shader: its surface shader is not drawn on terrain; the layer uses the built-in surface
engine.editor.terrain.layers.none: This terrain has no materials yet.
engine.editor.terrain.layers.none_how: Click + to pick one of the project's materials, or drag one here from Content. Its ground draws plain grey until then, and the first material is what that ground becomes.
engine.editor.terrain.layers.pick_none: No materials in the project yet. Right-click in Content: New Material, or New Terrain Starter Materials.
engine.editor.terrain.layers.remove_last: only the last material can be removed: the ground's voxels are numbered by their place in this list
engine.editor.terrain.layers.starters_ti: grass, sand, rock and five more, written under materials/terrain/ where they are not yet, and given to this terrain in one step
engine.editor.terrain.layers.swatch_tip: double-click to open, right-click for more; drop a material here to put it in this one's place
engine.editor.terrain.mask.height_tip: world heights: only ground whose voxels lie between them is painted
engine.editor.terrain.mask.title: Only where
engine.editor.terrain.mode.create_tip: make ground: flat, hills, or from a heightmap image
engine.editor.terrain.mode.foliage_tip: grow grass, flowers and trees on the ground
engine.editor.terrain.mode.paint_tip: choose what the ground is made of, by hand or by slope and height (Y)
engine.editor.terrain.mode.sculpt_tip: shape the ground: raise, lower, smooth, flatten, add, dig (T)
engine.editor.terrain.mode.setup_tip: the voxel size and the height range
engine.editor.terrain.paint.blend_tip: shows the material more with every stamp, over what is there
engine.editor.terrain.paint.brush_down: Press Paint, then drag over the ground.
engine.editor.terrain.paint.erase_tip: takes off what was painted over, a little at a time
engine.editor.terrain.paint.replace_tip: makes the ground the material outright
engine.editor.terrain.paint.softness_tip: how much of the brush fades out towards its rim: 0 is a hard edge, 50 fades across the outer half, 100 fades from the centre
engine.editor.terrain.paint.tip: changes what the ground is made of under the brush, without moving it
engine.editor.terrain.paint.under_tip: puts the material under what was painted over it
engine.editor.terrain.panel.no_ground: There is no ground to work on yet.
engine.editor.terrain.panel.no_terrain: This world has no terrain yet.
engine.editor.terrain.replace.tip: every voxel of the first, wherever it is, becomes the second. One ctrl-Z brings it back
engine.editor.terrain.replace.title: Replace a material everywhere
engine.editor.terrain.rules.apply_tip: writes what the rules draw into the ground's own materials, so a rule can be turned off afterwards with nothing changing
engine.editor.terrain.rules.blend_tip: how wide the edge is: degrees across a slope bound, metres across a height bound
engine.editor.terrain.rules.covers_tip: the layers this rule may paint over
engine.editor.terrain.rules.height_tip: from how high to how high, in world metres; -100000 and 100000 are open
engine.editor.terrain.rules.intro: what the ground looks like by slope and height, top rule last; drawn live, written only by Apply
engine.editor.terrain.rules.noise_tip: how ragged the edge is; 0 is a clean line
engine.editor.terrain.rules.on_tip: on or off; turning the slope rock off is how steep ground keeps its own layer
engine.editor.terrain.rules.slope_tip: from how steep to how steep, in degrees from level
engine.editor.terrain.rules.title: Paint by slope and height
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.add_tip: builds a ball of ground where you aim; hold still and it grows towards you. Ctrl digs
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.brush_down: Pick a tool, then drag on the ground in the viewport.
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.dig_tip: carves a ball out where you aim; hold still and it tunnels in. Ctrl adds
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.flatten_tip: levels the ground to one height: where the stroke starts, or one you set below
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.lower_tip: sinks the ground under the brush. Hold Ctrl to raise
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.new_ground: new ground is {name}; choose another under Paint
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.raise_tip: lifts the ground under the brush, most at its centre. Hold Ctrl to lower
engine.editor.terrain.sculpt.smooth_tip: softens bumps, fills pits and rounds off edges. Hold Shift with any tool to smooth
engine.editor.terrain.setup.lowest_tip: the deepest anything may dig. Set it before digging: a collider's precision is spread over this range
engine.editor.terrain.setup.none: Setup is the terrain's own: create one first.
engine.editor.terrain.setup.voxel_locked: only while the terrain is empty: changing it would resample every column. Clear All Ground, under Create, first
engine.editor.terrain.setup.voxel_tip: how coarse the ground is. Smaller resolves more and costs more
engine.editor.terrain.status.brush_too_b: the brush is too big for this terrain's voxels: make it smaller, or the voxels bigger under Setup
engine.editor.terrain.status.export_fail: could not write the heightmap under {folder}
engine.editor.terrain.status.export_need: open a project to export into
engine.editor.terrain.status.export_too_: that is more than 4096 columns across at this voxel size; export it smaller
engine.editor.terrain.status.exported: heightmaps/{name}.png and .r16, {columns} x {columns}, black {black} m, white {white} m
engine.editor.terrain.status.has_materia: the terrain already has that material
engine.editor.terrain.status.hills_spec: hills need a size, a scale, and a top above their bottom
engine.editor.terrain.status.hills_too_s: those hills are too steep for this size: make them lower, wider or smaller
engine.editor.terrain.status.import_spec: choose a heightmap, a size and a height range first
engine.editor.terrain.status.import_too_: that is more than 4096 columns across at this voxel size; import it smaller
{name} is too steep for this size: import it larger, or over a lower range
that image is too tall for its width at this size; import it smaller
engine.editor.terrain.status.imported_cl: {name}: {width} x {height} pixels onto {columns} x {rows} columns, clamped to the terrain's MinHeight and MaxHeight
engine.editor.terrain.status.no_material: this terrain has no materials yet: add one under Paint first
engine.editor.terrain.status.not_a_heigh: {name} is not a heightmap this can read: {reason}
engine.editor.terrain.status.nothing_to_: there is no ground to export
nothing thinned here to restore: where a layer grows is set by its density, slope and height, in Properties
engine.editor.terrain.status.nowhere: this world has nowhere to put terrain
engine.editor.terrain.status.replace_non: no ground of that material to replace
engine.editor.terrain.status.replace_too: this terrain is too big to replace a material across at once

engine.editor.terrain.status.rules_appli.one: {count} voxel now holds what the rules drew
engine.editor.terrain.status.rules_appli.other: {count} voxels now hold what the rules drew

engine.editor.terrain.status.rules_nothi: the voxels already are what the rules draw
engine.editor.terrain.status.rules_too_b: this terrain is too big to apply the rules to at once
engine.editor.terrain.status.square_too_: that square is too big for this terrain's voxels: make it smaller, or the voxels bigger under Setup
engine.editor.terrain.status.starters_gi: the terrain has the {count} starter materials
engine.editor.terrain.status.starters_ha: this terrain has materials already; add the starters one by one with +
engine.editor.terrain.status.starters_ne: open a project to write the starter materials into
engine.editor.terrain.status.starters_th: the starter terrain materials are already in materials/terrain

engine.editor.terrain.status.starters_wr.one: wrote {count} starter terrain material to materials/terrain
engine.editor.terrain.status.starters_wr.other: wrote {count} starter terrain materials to materials/terrain

engine.editor.terrain.status.too_many_co: that is more than 4096 columns across at this voxel size; make it smaller
engine.editor.terrain.status.too_many_ma: a terrain has at most {count} materials
